capabilities: Browse notes as cards, grid tiles or widescreen image galleries
Filter notes and folders by title, tag or category with live search
Create, rename, move and archive notes and folders from context menus
Mark notes as favorites stored in frontmatter
Dock the explorer as a workspace tab or in the left sidebar
disambiguation: Not a graph or link explorer; it browses vault files as visual cards, thumbnails being extracted from note content.
extras: Settings can be exported to a JSON file in the vault to survive uninstalling and sync across devices; UI is German or English, with German as the default language.
problem: Obsidian's native file explorer shows only filenames, so browsing notes visually by image, category or preview is not possible out of the box.
summary: Card-based note browser that displays notes as a list, grid or widescreen gallery with image thumbnails, tags, dates and previews.
